cases.name: secondary-override
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return value+2;}};int run(B& b){return b.b();}int main(){D d;d.value=5;return run(d)!=7;}

cases.name: secondary-inherited
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{};int run(B& b){return b.b();}int main(){D d;d.value=7;return run(d)!=7;}

cases.name: deep-overrides
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct C:A,B{};struct D:C{int b()override{return value+2;}};int run(B* b){return b->b();}int main(){D d;d.value=5;return run(&d)!=7;}

cases.name: later-primary
cases.source: struct Data{int n;};struct A{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct D:Data,A{int f(){return n;}};int run(A& a){return a.f();}int main(){D d;d.n=9;return run(d)!=9||sizeof(D)!=16;}

cases.name: primary-ancestor-slots
cases.source: struct Data{int n;};struct A{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct B:A{virtual int g(){return 2;}};struct D:Data,B{int f(){return n;}int g(){return n+1;}};int run(B& b){return b.f()+b.g();}int main(){D d;d.n=9;return run(d)!=19;}

cases.name: unrelated-roots
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f(){return 3;}};struct B{virtual int f(){return 5;}};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;A&a=d;B&b=d;return a.f()!=3||b.f()!=5;}

cases.name: repeated-roots
cases.source: struct A{int n;virtual int f(){return n;}};struct B:A{};struct C:A{};struct D:B,C{};int main(){D d;B&b=d;C&c=d;b.n=3;c.n=5;A&x=b;A&y=c;return x.f()!=3||y.f()!=5;}

cases.name: all-roots-override
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f(){return 3;}};struct B{virtual int f(){return 5;}};struct D:A,B{int n;int f(){return n;}};int main(){D d;d.n=7;A&a=d;B&b=d;return a.f()!=7||b.f()!=7;}

cases.name: triple-view
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int g(){return 2;}};struct C{virtual int h(){return 3;}};struct D:A,B,C{int f(){return 4;}int g(){return 5;}int h(){return 6;}};int main(){D d;A&a=d;B&b=d;C&c=d;return a.f()+b.g()+c.h()!=15;}

cases.name: forward-arguments
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual double f(int i,double d)=0;};struct D:A,B{int n;double f(int i,double d){return n+i+d;}};int main(){D d;d.n=3;B&b=d;return b.f(4,0.5)!=7.5;}

cases.name: value-return
cases.source: struct S{int n;};struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual S f()=0;};struct D:A,B{S f(){S s={7};return s;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.f().n!=7;}

cases.name: indirect-return
cases.source: struct S{int n;~S(){}};struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual S f()=0;};struct D:A,B{S f(){S s;s.n=7;return s;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.f().n!=7;}

cases.name: template-views
cases.source: template<int I>struct A{virtual int f(){return I;}};struct D:A<3>,A<5>{};int main(){D d;A<3>&a=d;A<5>&b=d;return a.f()!=3||b.f()!=5;}

cases.name: static-downcast
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{int n;};D* back(B*p){return static_cast<D*>(p);}int main(){D d;d.n=7;B*b=&d;return back(b)!=&d||back(0)!=0||static_cast<D&>(*b).n!=7;}

cases.name: global-views
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return value+2;}};D d;int main(){d.value=5;B&b=d;return b.b()!=7;}

cases.name: crosscast-null-and-miss
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{};B* cross(A*a){return dynamic_cast<B*>(a);}int main(){D d;A a;return cross(&d)!=static_cast<B*>(&d)||cross(&a)!=0||cross(0)!=0;}

cases.name: typeid-secondary
cases.source: namespace std{struct type_info{bool operator==(const type_info&)const;bool operator!=(const type_info&)const;};}struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{};bool run(B&b){return typeid(b)==typeid(D);}int main(){D d;return !run(d);}

cases.name: rtti-top
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int value;virtual int b(){return value;}};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;B*b=&d;return dynamic_cast<void*>(b)!=static_cast<void*>(&d);}

cases.name: secondary-covariance
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int n;virtual B* self(){return this;}};struct D:A,B{D* self(){return this;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.self()!=static_cast<B*>(&d);}

cases.name: secondary-covariance-null
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual B* self(){return this;}};struct D:A,B{D* self(){return 0;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return b.self()!=0;}

cases.name: primary-covariance
cases.source: struct Pad{int n;};struct R{int r;};struct Result:Pad,R{};struct A{virtual R* get()=0;};struct B:A{Result value;Result* get(){return &value;}};int main(){B b;A&a=b;B&d=b;return a.get()!=static_cast<R*>(&b.value)||d.get()!=&b.value;}

cases.name: covariance-reference
cases.source: struct Pad{int n;};struct R{int r;};struct Result:Pad,R{};struct A{virtual int f(){return 0;}};struct B{virtual R& get()=0;};struct D:A,B{Result value;Result& get(){return value;}};int main(){D d;B&b=d;return &b.get()!=static_cast<R*>(&d.value);}

cases.name: later-final-overrider
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{int n;virtual int b(){return n;}};struct C:A,B{int b(){return n+1;}};struct P{virtual int p(){return 0;}};struct D:P,C{};int main(){D d;d.n=6;C&c=d;B&b=d;return c.b()!=7||b.b()!=7;}

cases.name: crosscast-private-base
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct B:A{};struct C:private A{};struct D:B,C{};C* cross(A*a){return dynamic_cast<C*>(a);}int main(){D d;B&b=d;return cross(&b)!=static_cast<C*>(&d);}

cases.name: repeated-source-downcast
cases.source: struct A{virtual int f(){return 1;}};struct B:A{};struct C:A{};struct D:B,C{};D* back(A*a){return dynamic_cast<D*>(a);}int main(){D d;B&b=d;C&c=d;return back(&b)!=&d||back(&c)!=&d;}

cases.name: virtual-member-pointer
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 2;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 7;}};int main(){D d;int(D::*p)()=&B::b;return (d.*p)()!=7;}

cases.name: late-complete-rtti
cases.source: namespace std{struct type_info{bool operator==(const type_info&)const;};}struct D;const std::type_info& get(){return typeid(D*);}struct A{};struct B{};struct D:A,B{};int main(){return !(get()==typeid(D*));}

cases.name: exception-rtti
cases.source: struct A{int a;};struct B{int b;};struct D:A,B{};int main(){try{D d;d.a=3;d.b=7;throw d;}catch(B&b){return b.b!=7;}}

cases.name: secondary-pure-reject
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b()=0;};struct D:A,B{};int main(){D d;}

cases.name: secondary-final-reject
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b()final{return 1;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 2;}};

cases.name: secondary-exception-reject
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b()noexcept{return 1;}};struct D:A,B{int b(){return 2;}};

cases.name: secondary-static-reject
cases.source: struct A{virtual int a(){return 1;}};struct B{virtual int b(){return 1;}};struct D:A,B{static int b(){return 2;}};
